newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: IFC offers to underwrite Manila Europeso bond.
newsitem.headline: IFC offers to underwrite Manila Europeso bond.

text.p: The International Finance Corp (IFC) has offered to lead manage up to $70 million worth of inaugural Philippine peso-denominated Eurobonds or "Europesos", Central Bank Governor Gabriel Singson said.

The IFC, the investment banking arm of the World Bank, is the fourth international firm or institution to offer to underwrite the country's first Europeso flotation, Central Bank Governor Gabriel Singson told reporters at the weekend.
Previous offers came from corporate bond arranger ING-Barings, investment house Merrill Lynch and Deutsche Morgan Grenfell (DMG), a subsidiary of the German Deutsche Bank group .
The offers are being evaluated by the Central Bank's external debt department.
Under the proposals, investors would use the local currency as a denomination for new international debt instruments, Central Bank officials said.
Besides creating a more diverse investor base for Philippine debt, Europesos could also induce growth of the domestic bond market, the officials said.
